mapper.select: select cr.register_id as registerId, cr.competition_id as competitionId, cr.team_id as teamId, cr.team_name as teamName, cr.team_members as teamMembers, cr.register_time as registerTime, cr.work_name as workName, c.competition_name as competitionName from competition_register cr left join competition c on cr.competition_id = c.competition_id where cr.user_id = #{userId} order by cr.register_time desc limit #{limit}

select cr.register_id as registerId, cr.competition_id as competitionId, cr.team_id as teamId, cr.team_name as teamName, cr.team_members as teamMembers, cr.register_time as registerTime, cr.work_name as workName, c.competition_name as competitionName from competition_register cr left join competition c on cr.competition_id = c.competition_id where cr.user_id = #{userId} and ( cr.team_id is not null or exists ( select 1 from competition_participation cp where cp.participation_id = cr.register_id and cp.submit_time is not null and cp.ppt_path is not null and cp.ppt_path != '' and cp.pdf_path is not null and cp.pdf_path != '' ) ) and ( cr.team_id is null or #{studentNo} is null or JSON_SEARCH(cr.team_members, 'one', #{studentNo}, null, '$[*].studentNo') is not null ) order by cr.register_time desc, cr.register_id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select count(1) from competition_register cr where cr.user_id = #{userId} and ( cr.team_id is not null or exists ( select 1 from competition_participation cp where cp.participation_id = cr.register_id and cp.submit_time is not null and cp.ppt_path is not null and cp.ppt_path != '' and cp.pdf_path is not null and cp.pdf_path != '' ) ) and ( cr.team_id is null or #{studentNo} is null or JSON_SEARCH(cr.team_members, 'one', #{studentNo}, null, '$[*].studentNo') is not null )
